gloss: at a stroke, all at once

definitions.gloss: at a stroke, all at once, in one go
definitions.explanation: Doing something all at once or in a single action, rather than gradually or in stages.

examples.japanese: {一挙|いっきょ}に{解決|かいけつ}する。
examples.english: To resolve everything at a stroke.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}を{一挙|いっきょ}に{片付|かたづ}けた。
examples.english: I dealt with the problems all at once.

examples.japanese: あのゴールで{流|なが}れが{変|か}わり、{一挙|いっきょ}に{三点|さんてん}を{奪|うば}った。
examples.english: That goal changed the momentum, and they scored three points in one burst.

notes:
{一挙|いっきょ} means doing something all at once or in a single decisive action. It is most commonly used as an adverb ({一挙|いっきょ}に).

FORMS:
{一|いっ} (one) + {挙|きょ} (raise, action) = one action

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一挙|いっきょ}に: all at once, in one go
- {一挙|いっきょ}{両得|りょうとく}: killing two birds with one stone
- {一挙|いっきょ}{一動|いちどう}: every move, every action
- {一挙|いっきょ}{放送|ほうそう}: marathon broadcast (airing all episodes at once)

USAGE:
{一挙|いっきょ}{放送|ほうそう} and {一挙|いっきょ}{公開|こうかい} are commonly seen in TV and streaming contexts, meaning a binge-style broadcast or release of multiple episodes at once.
